title: SwiftData 持久化集成
html:
SwiftData 持久化集成

核心概念

SwiftData（WWDC 2023 发布，iOS 17+）是 Apple 的 Swift 原生持久化框架，用 @Model 宏替代 Core Data 的 NSManagedObject + xcdatamodeld 模型文件。它与 SwiftUI 深度集成：@Query 属性包装器自动执行 fetch 并驱动视图刷新，ModelContainer 通过 Environment 注入，整个数据层在声明式范式中自然流动。2026 年随着 Observation 框架的成熟，SwiftData 对象现在具备属性级精准追踪——视图只因实际读取的属性变化而刷新。

flowchart LR
    subgraph SD["SwiftData Stack"]
        Model["@Model 类定义"] --> Container[ModelContainer]
        Container --> Context[ModelContext]
        Context --> CRUD[增删改查]
    end
    subgraph SUI["SwiftUI 集成"]
        Query["@Query"] --> View[View body]
        Env[".modelContainer"] --> Context
        View -->|insert/delete| Context
    end
    Container -.->|自动迁移| SQLite[(SQLite)]
概念 Core Data SwiftData
模型定义 .xcdatamodeld + NSManagedObject 子类 @Model class（纯 Swift）
容器 NSPersistentContainer ModelContainer
上下文 NSManagedObjectContext ModelContext
查询 NSFetchRequest + NSFetchedResultsController @Query 属性包装器
关系 GUI 编辑器 + 代码生成 直接 Swift 属性 + 类型推断
迁移 Mapping Model + 手动迁移策略 自动轻量迁移 + VersionedSchema
Observation 对象级（@ObservedObject） 属性级（Observation 框架）

@Model 宏定义模型

import SwiftData

@Model
final class Task {
    var title: String
    var isCompleted: Bool
    var dueDate: Date?
    var priority: Priority

    @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \SubTask.parentTask)
    var subTasks: [SubTask]

    @Attribute(.externalStorage)
    var attachmentData: Data?

    init(title: String, priority: Priority = .medium) {
        self.title = title
        self.isCompleted = false
        self.priority = priority
        self.subTasks = []
    }
}

@Model
final class SubTask {
    var name: String
    var isCompleted: Bool
    var parentTask: Task?

    init(name: String) {
        self.name = name
        self.isCompleted = false
    }
}

enum Priority: Int, Codable, CaseIterable {
    case low, medium, high, critical
}

@Model 宏自动合成持久化所需的元数据，属性类型需要遵循 Codable。@Relationship 定义关系和级联删除规则，@Attribute(.externalStorage) 将大数据存储在外部文件。

ModelContainer 配置与注入

@main
struct TaskApp: App {
    var body: some Scene {
        WindowGroup {
            ContentView()
        }
        .modelContainer(for: [Task.self, SubTask.self], inMemory: false)
    }
}

自定义配置：

let config = ModelConfiguration(
    "TaskStore",
    schema: Schema([Task.self, SubTask.self]),
    url: .documentsDirectory.appending(path: "tasks.store"),
    allowsSave: true,
    cloudKitDatabase: .automatic
)

let container = try ModelContainer(
    for: Task.self, SubTask.self,
    configurations: config
)

@Query 声明式查询

struct TaskListView: View {
    @Query(
        filter: #Predicate<Task> { !$0.isCompleted },
        sort: [SortDescriptor(\.dueDate, order: .forward)],
        animation: .default
    )
    private var pendingTasks: [Task]

    @Query(
        filter: #Predicate<Task> { $0.isCompleted },
        sort: [SortDescriptor(\.dueDate, order: .reverse)]
    )
    private var completedTasks: [Task]

    var body: some View {
        List {
            Section("待完成 (\(pendingTasks.count))") {
                ForEach(pendingTasks) { task in
                    TaskRow(task: task)
                }
            }
            Section("已完成") {
                ForEach(completedTasks) { task in
                    TaskRow(task: task)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

动态 filter 需要用 init 注入：

struct FilteredTaskList: View {
    @Query private var tasks: [Task]

    init(priority: Priority) {
        _tasks = Query(
            filter: #Predicate<Task> { task in
                task.priority.rawValue >= priority.rawValue
            },
            sort: [SortDescriptor(\.dueDate)]
        )
    }

    var body: some View {
        ForEach(tasks) { TaskRow(task: $0) }
    }
}

CRUD 操作

通过 @Environment(\.modelContext) 获取上下文：

struct AddTaskView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @State private var title = ""
    @State private var priority: Priority = .medium

    var body: some View {
        Form {
            TextField("任务名称", text: $title)
            Picker("优先级", selection: $priority) {
                ForEach(Priority.allCases, id: \.self) { p in
                    Text(p.description)
                }
            }
            Button("创建") {
                let task = Task(title: title, priority: priority)
                context.insert(task)
                // 自动保存（autosave 默认开启）
            }
        }
    }
}

// 删除
func delete(task: Task) {
    context.delete(task)
}

// 批量操作
try context.delete(model: Task.self, where: #Predicate { $0.isCompleted })

VersionedSchema 数据迁移

enum TaskSchemaV1: VersionedSchema {
    static var versionIdentifier = Schema.Version(1, 0, 0)
    static var models: [any PersistentModel.Type] { [Task.self] }

    @Model
    final class Task {
        var title: String
        var isCompleted: Bool
    }
}

enum TaskSchemaV2: VersionedSchema {
    static var versionIdentifier = Schema.Version(2, 0, 0)
    static var models: [any PersistentModel.Type] { [Task.self] }

    @Model
    final class Task {
        var title: String
        var isCompleted: Bool
        var priority: Int  // 新增字段
    }
}

enum TaskMigrationPlan: SchemaMigrationPlan {
    static var schemas: [any VersionedSchema.Type] { [TaskSchemaV1.self, TaskSchemaV2.self] }

    static var stages: [MigrationStage] {
        [migrateV1toV2]
    }

    static let migrateV1toV2 = MigrationStage.lightweight(
        fromVersion: TaskSchemaV1.self,
        toVersion: TaskSchemaV2.self
    )
}

小结

  • SwiftData 用 @Model 宏将 Swift class 直接映射为持久化实体，零 XML 配置
  • @Query 在 View 中声明式执行查询，自动响应数据变化驱动 UI 刷新
  • ModelContext 通过 Environment 注入，CRUD 操作自然融入 SwiftUI 生命周期
  • Observation 框架赋予 SwiftData 对象属性级追踪，仅读取的属性变化触发刷新
  • VersionedSchema + MigrationPlan 处理 schema 演进，支持轻量和自定义迁移
